question: Can the file a buyer downloads be replaced over the Gumroad v2 API, with no owner action?
probe: Against throwaway products created and deleted in the same run: route probes with a documented and a fabricated control, form-encoded PUT probes with a fake-parameter control, a real multipart/form-data upload with bytes, a hunt for the presigned upload endpoint the API's own refusal names, the same file parameter given a URL we own that answers 200 rather than one that cannot resolve, and a creation carrying a file.

real_url_put.message: File URLs must reference your own uploaded files. Use the presigned upload endpoint to upload files first.
real_url_put.reads_as: the refusal does not depend on whether the URL resolves, so it is about ownership of the file rather than the value — replacement by an external URL is closed, not unproven

relisting.message: File URLs must reference your own uploaded files. Use the presigned upload endpoint to upload files first.
relisting.reads_as: creation was REFUSED by the same file-ownership rule the PUT hit, and no product was made at all — so the listing rail cannot carry a download either, reached from the other side. This is an answer, not a gap.

verdict_reason: no candidate route answers differently from a path that was never defined; a real multipart upload with bytes was refused; the throwaway's file shape did not move; the presigned upload endpoint the API's own refusal names is absent from this surface (12 path/method pairs, all byte-identical to a path that was never defined); and files[][url] returns the IDENTICAL refusal for a URL we own that answers 200 as for a URL that cannot resolve, so it rejects external URLs as such rather than rejecting a bad value. The file a buyer downloads cannot be replaced over this API surface. Nor can creation carry one: a create sent WITH files[][url] was refused by the identical file-ownership rule and produced no product at all, so the listing rail delivers a price and a description and no download. Attaching bytes is outside this API entirely — a measured ceiling rather than a gap in the probing, and the strongest owner-request candidate on the board.

why_it_is_absent_and_what_would_reach_it.status: SOURCED, NOT VERIFIED HERE. Every claim below carries a URL and a verbatim quote, and no lap has opened any of them. They are checkable — the sources are the PUBLIC Gumroad source repository (github.com/antiwork/gumroad), which this session can read through the GitHub tools. Until one lap does, this is a good answer rather than a measurement, and the distinction is the one this register keeps breaking.
why_it_is_absent_and_what_would_reach_it.finding: The upload path exists and is NOT in /v2 at all, which is why 12 probes found nothing. The dashboard uploads through Evaporate.js straight to S3, signing every part against gumroad.com/s3_utility/generate_multipart_signature, a SESSION-authenticated endpoint. The quoted line from the implementing pull request: "The web frontend does this via Evaporate and a session-authenticated signing endpoint, neither of which is accessible to OAuth clients." Only after the bytes are in S3 does the resulting URL become acceptable to PUT /v2/products/:id files[][url] — which is exactly the refusal we measured, read from the other side.
why_it_is_absent_and_what_would_reach_it.what_it_would_take: A logged-in Gumroad session cookie with seller admin rights, carried into CI, plus the S3 key rule the dashboard uses. That is a credential this lane does not hold and has no documented way to obtain or refresh. So the verdict not_replaceable stands for the credential we have, and the reason is now specific rather than an absence: it is not that the door is missing, it is that it opens for a different key.
why_it_is_absent_and_what_would_reach_it.also_learned: No replace operation exists at all — the shape is add-then-remove, the whole files list must be resent, and a file still referenced by rich content cannot be removed in the same update. Free products cap at 250 MB total. Buyers see current files, so a replacement would reach existing purchasers.
why_it_is_absent_and_what_would_reach_it.the_lead_worth_one_lap: The sources are a public repository this session can READ. Verifying two quotes (the pull request line and s3_utility_controller.rb) would convert this whole block from sourced to measured, and would also settle whether the S3 key rule is derivable rather than guessed. Cheap, and it is the only remaining way the priced listing could ever ship a fix unattended.
